mechanism: Both drugs block dopamine receptors and have overlapping CNS depressant effects; tetrabenazine inhibits VMAT2 while chlorpromazine is a typical antipsychotic, creating additive antidopaminergic activity and increased risk of extrapyramidal side effects and neuroleptic malignant syndrome.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use only with careful monitoring and dose adjustment; if combination necessary, monitor closely for extrapyramidal symptoms, neuroleptic malignant syndrome, and excessive sedation.
